resources.string: Illustrated variant: say Allahu akbar and bow slightly, keeping your arms close and your palms on your thighs above your knees, fingers together. Pause calmly. This hand placement is awaiting a supporting reference; the recitation source below does not verify the pose.

Say Allahu akbar and lower into prostration. In this compact variant, keep your limbs close and your abdomen near your thighs, with your forehead, nose and palms resting on the prayer mat. Pause before reciting.
Say Allahu akbar and make the second prostration in the same compact posture. Rest your forehead, nose and palms on the mat and pause before reciting.
Say Allahu akbar and sit upright on the mat, with both feet folded to your right. Rest your hands on your thighs, fingers together and pointing forward. Pause, then ask Allah for forgiveness.
Sit upright with both feet folded to your right. Rest your left hand on your thigh and extend your right index finger for the tashahhud. Recite calmly.
